answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, agents must bind each state delta to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Rather than allow identities to wander freely across clusters, the network enforces exponential staking deposits for coordinated batches. If an adversarial entity deploys a synthetic swarm—even one generating a unique sonnet per node to simulate genuine cognitive effort—the exponential capital exhaustion makes sustained disruption mathematically unviable.
